items.title: At PLAN, run the workspace-resolution audit fixture and record its flagged-caller list in plan.md as the migration scope
items.context: The audit fixture from single-owner-extraction-readers-parsers enumerates resolveGitCwd callers by grep and classifies each; paste its output into plan.md rather than restating it.

items.title: Migrate every flagged handler onto the shared workspace resolver with a per-caller cross-checkout regression case
items.context: Model each case on B-a745's F-010 fixtures: invoke from the story worktree and from the main checkout (bypassing any cwd gate the way validate --story does) and assert identical output.

items.title: Finish only when the audit fixture reports zero flagged callers and runs in the canonical inventories
items.context: The terminal assertion is the audit itself; register it in test:serial-reference plus RESOURCE_POLICY so a future caller that regresses is caught.
